name: TraceCheck
description: Independent evaluation service for AI agent execution traces. Submit a goal, trace, and outcome to receive a reliability score (0-100), per-dimension sub-scores, detected issues and concrete process-improvement suggestions. No content needed: send step types only (privacy-light format); no goal/trace/outcome text is logged or stored. Free during test phase, no API key. Designed for agents that want to verify their own work or improve long-horizon reliability. Also available as an MCP server (streamable HTTP) at https://tracecheck-mcp.onrender.com/mcp with tools evaluate_trace and get_trace_schema.

skills.name: Evaluate agent execution trace
skills.description: Score an agent's multi-step execution trace for reliability and return concrete improvement suggestions. No content needed: send step types only. Send POST /a2a/message:send (or JSON-RPC message/send at POST /a2a) with one message part {"data": {"goal": str, "trace": str | list, "outcome": str, "agent_name": str (optional)}}. Privacy-light (recommended): goal = a generic category ('data lookup'), outcome = 'success'|'partial'|'failed', trace = step types + statuses only, e.g. [{"type":"action","tool":"search","status":"ok"},{"type":"error"},{"type":"retry"},{"type":"verify","status":"passed"}] or 'action:search ok > error > retry > verify passed'. Free text also works: chronological steps, one per line, with what each tool returned, errors with their recovery, and a final 'Verified:' line. Nothing you send is logged or stored, only the score and counts. Returns a Message whose data part is {score, dimensions, issues, suggestions, summary, privacy_mode, version}. Loop: run task, evaluate, apply suggestions, re-run, compare.
examples: Evaluate this trace for the goal 'book a flight and confirm the reservation'.
Check if my multi-step research process completed correctly and suggest improvements.
{"goal": "data lookup", "trace": "action:search ok > action:fetch_details error > retry:fetch_details ok > verify passed", "outcome": "success"}

{"goal": "Find the cheapest direct flight AMS->LIS on 12 March and report price and flight number", "trace": "1. Called search_flights(...)\n2. Observed: returned 4 flights...\n3. Verified: matches goal", "outcome": "KL1693, EUR 89"}
